parameters.query: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.role, u.telegram_chat_id, uc.company_id FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_companies uc ON uc.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = $1 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, task_title, default_owner_role, days_offset FROM ops_task_templates WHERE service_type = 'employee_onboarding' ORDER BY days_offset ASC NULLS LAST
SELECT u.id FROM users u JOIN user_companies uc ON uc.user_id = u.id WHERE u.role = 'coo' AND uc.company_id = $1 LIMIT 1
INSERT INTO ops_projects (company_id, name, owner_id, status, description) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'active', $4) RETURNING id, company_id, owner_id
